review_candidates.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
review_candidates.description: We're making energy fair, clean, and simple for all using technology. Octopus Energy started with a bold idea: to build Britain’s first truly digital energy supplier. By combining world-class tech with brilliant humans who care deeply about customers and driving the renewable energy transition, we made it happen and in 2025, we became Britain’s largest energy supplier. Octopus Energy Group is a global energy transition collective. 10 businesses working across 4 continents to tackle energy transformation at nearly every front. And we constantly push to make energy better. Tirelessly campaigning for fair protections for customers. And building innovative technologies that forge a path to a green energy system. We’re made up of 10,000+ authentic, committed people working around the world on stuff you'd never expect. We're united by a shared goal: to drive the global green energy revolution. Read our Spotlight series to meet some of the team. We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (frontend focus) to join our Low Carbon Tech team. Low Carbon Tech are installing EV Chargers, Solar, Batteries and Heat Pumps into homes to drive the energy transition at pace. As customer demand grows, our goal is to ensure scaling up never means slowing down or compromising on a world-class customer journey for low carbon tech. To make that happen, we are building a new, dedicated engineering and product team to completely re-imagine this process - making it fast, transparent, and predictable for our customers from day one. This will be a small multi-disciplinary team who’ll sit within our much bigger low carbon tech team. You’ll help design and build the platform architecture, data integrations, and automations that eliminate real world friction. If you want to design and build solutions to scale up electrotech in the nation’s homes, this is the mission for you. We embrace flat hierarchies and an open, agile culture that fosters innovation, flexibility, and creativity. We don’t hang our personalities up with our coats and nor should you. At Octopus, we hire great people who get stuff done, all whilst being themselves. If this sounds exciting, we’d love to chat. What you'll do Serve as a bridge across our entire stack, building end-to-end capabilities while helping frontend developers get comfortable with backend/infra and vice versa Take full ownership of features end-to-end, delivering reliable, production-ready code with plenty of autonomy Shape the architecture of brand-new projects from scratch while giving our existing codebases the refactoring love they need Maintain high frontend standards in AI-assisted workflows by vetting AI outputs, catching edge cases, and protecting long-term code health Communicate technical ideas clearly and concisely, prioritising high-signal context Keep our releases smooth with automated CI/CD workflows and set up production monitoring to track app health Work closely with product managers and designers to find the leanest, most efficient paths to ship value What you'll have 5+ years of experience with our stack (listed below) Experience taking problems, rather than strict guidelines, and developing strong solutions Confidence owning the development cycle (request, requirements gathering, technical proposal, technical execution, deployment and monitoring.) Confidence tackling large-scale tasks individually An empathetic approach to delegating work and collaborating with others The ability to develop websites that meet strong accessibility guidelines Experience building scalable, performant sites that handle high levels of traffic well Eager to drive cross-functional work spanning frontend, backend, DevOps, and infrastructure. Pragmatic AI mindset, experience with AI Workflows & Tooling: building harnesses, custom agent skills, MCP integrations, token minimisation strategies, etc. Desirable: energy domain knowledge Our stack React (required) TypeScript (required) Next.js on Vercel (required) Backend Python, Django (required) Testing infrastructure (Playwright, vitest, MSW), observability (Datadog, Sentry), CI (Github, CircleCI) (required) GraphQL w/ Tanstack Query (desirable) PostgreSQL, Celery, and asynchronous background processing (desirable) Why else you'll love it here • Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit! • Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture . An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! We were named the UK's top company to work for in 2025, and we ranked in the top ten in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2026. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership • Visit our UK perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you, tell us what you care about, why Octopus feels right and most importantly, bring us the real you! Applying for jobs can be a bit scary so have a nose through some of our tips first 🚀 P.S. Our process usually takes up to 4 weeks, but we’ll always do our best to flex around what works for you. Along the way, you’ll chat with our recruitment team and your Recruiter will help you throughout different stages. Got any burning questions before then? Drop us a message at talent@octoenergy.com and we’d love to help! Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic! Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone. Where necessary, we sometimes use AI tools to help with parts of our hiring process, like reviewing applications or assessing responses. We’re lucky to receive a huge amount of interest, so these tools help our recruiters manage that volume, not replace them. Ultimately, every hiring decision (for example, whether to progress your application or not) is always made by a real person in our Talent team. If you’d like to know more about how we use your data, you can reach out to us via email at talent@octoenergy.com. We’re happy to help!

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: TME Systems is a premier high-tech solutions and services provider, established in 1987 and headquartered in Singapore, with a strong presence across Southeast Asia. In collaboration with globally recognized partners, we deliver cutting-edge products and innovative solutions across diverse markets, including Test & Measurement, Software, Academic & Research, Energy & Electrification, and NI Solutions. TME Systems is seeking experienced Full-Time Software Engineer to support our ongoing business growth and expansion. We are looking for passionate, dedicated professionals to join our Software Business Unit and help deliver innovative solutions that enable our customers to achieve their business objectives. Responsibilities Provide technical support and training for TME Software-based solution. Collaborate with customers to understand their workflows and develop effective solution proposals Create application example demonstrations tailored to customer needs Work with sales teams to support and develop account strategies Travel as needed to support onsite customer technical meetings, workshops, and presentations Stay updated with the latest software solution releases and industry developments To be successful in this role, you should have: Technical Skills In-depth knowledge of either Modeling & Simulation or Real-Time Operating Systems Strong background in engineering or computer science Proficiency in programming languages such as C/C++/C#, Python, or similar Ability to understand and address customer technical requirements Experience in developing and delivering technical demonstrations on the use of software technologies in system program design Experience with technical solution proposals A passion for learning new software technologies is advantageous Soft Skills Excellent communication and presentation abilities Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills Attention to detail Strong interpersonal skills and a customer-focused approach for building lasting relationships Ability to work both independently and collaboratively Flexibility to manage multiple projects and multitask effectively Willingness to travel and adapt to different cultural environments What We offer Attractive remuneration package Good working culture and management Work-life balance Career progression and personal growth opportunities Remarks: Kindly include your expected salary in your resume when applying for this position
